title: Southward Journey and Banda Bahadur Opening

blocks.text: This transition page closes Guru Gobind Singh’s movement toward the south. Sodhi Kaul of Kothey Guru hears that his son has gone with the Guru and sends men after him; the son is brought back along with the bed on which he was sleeping.

When the Guru asks for the young man, the attendants find the tent empty. As other Malwa people also turn back, only the families of Bhai Mohan, Bhagata, Bahlo, and Rupa continue with the Guru and receive his blessing.
The page then opens the first Banda Bahadur episode at Dadu Duar, where Guru Gobind Singh camps with thousands of Singhs amid flags, drums, and fearless recitation of Gurbani.
